skills.name: jakarta-namespace
skills.description: Migrates Java EE javax namespaces to Jakarta while retaining JDK-owned javax packages.
skills.useWhen: A Spring Boot 3 or Jakarta upgrade specifically requires namespace mapping and verification.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The issue is RestClient, Maven configuration, a retained JDK javax import, or an exact local replacement already supplied.

skills.name: restclient-migration
skills.description: Migrates synchronous Spring RestTemplate calls to Spring 6.1 RestClient while preserving behavior.
skills.useWhen: A synchronous Spring HTTP client must move from RestTemplate to RestClient with method and error parity.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The target is WebClient/reactive, a controller route, a namespace migration, or a fully specified local edit.

skills.name: spring-boot-testing
skills.description: Selects focused Spring Boot test slices and resources for MVC, persistence, and REST clients.
skills.useWhen: A Spring Boot component needs a focused test slice or a RestClient-specific test procedure.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task is a Maven root-cause diagnosis, namespace migration, or an already specified assertion edit.

skills.name: java-junit
skills.description: Designs focused Java unit tests with JUnit lifecycle, parameterization, and assertions.
skills.useWhen: The only missing procedure is a Java unit-test design or JUnit test structure.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The request is build diagnosis, HTTP client migration, or an exact assertion already given.

skills.name: java-springboot
skills.description: Provides broad Spring Boot implementation conventions across API, data, validation, and services.
skills.useWhen: A general Spring Boot implementation needs framework conventions rather than a narrow migration.
skills.doNotUseWhen: A narrow Jakarta, RestClient, Security, Hibernate, or Maven procedure is the unique gap.

skills.name: create-spring-boot-java-project
skills.description: Scaffolds a new Spring Boot Java project with a deliberate dependency and package layout.
skills.useWhen: The deliverable is a new Spring Boot project rather than a change to an existing repository.
skills.doNotUseWhen: An existing project only needs migration, testing, or build repair.

skills.name: maven-build-lifecycle
skills.description: Diagnoses Maven phase, goal, profile, module-order, and lifecycle execution problems.
skills.useWhen: The failure is uniquely about which Maven phase/profile/module is executed and in what order.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The evidence identifies a dependency conflict or a plugin configuration defect.

skills.name: maven-dependency-management
skills.description: Diagnoses Maven version mediation, convergence, dependencyManagement, exclusions, and scopes.
skills.useWhen: The failing build evidence uniquely points to dependency resolution or version convergence.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The root cause is a lifecycle/profile choice, plugin execution, or ordinary Java compilation.

skills.name: maven-plugin-configuration
skills.description: Diagnoses Maven plugin versions, executions, goals, inherited configuration, and parameters.
skills.useWhen: The build evidence uniquely identifies a plugin execution or plugin parameter defect.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The root cause is dependency mediation, lifecycle phase selection, or source code semantics.

skills.name: spring-boot-migration
skills.description: Coordinates a broad Spring Boot 2-to-3 and Java baseline migration across several subsystems.
skills.useWhen: The task genuinely spans the complete Spring Boot platform upgrade and its ordered workstreams.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Only namespace, RestClient, Security, Hibernate, or one local edit is requested.

skills.name: spring-security-6
skills.description: Migrates Spring Security configuration to the Spring Security 6 component-based model.
skills.useWhen: SecurityFilterChain, request authorization, password encoding, or method security is the unique migration gap.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task concerns only namespace mapping, RestClient, or Maven build mechanics.

skills.name: hibernate-upgrade
skills.description: Migrates Hibernate/JPA mapping and query behavior across a framework upgrade.
skills.useWhen: The missing procedure is specifically Hibernate mapping, dialect, query, or persistence behavior migration.
skills.doNotUseWhen: Only import namespaces, HTTP client code, or Maven configuration is in scope.

skills.name: jackson-security
skills.description: Diagnoses and repairs Jackson deserialization and parser-boundary security flaws.
skills.useWhen: The task is a Java JSON deserialization vulnerability with adversarial and legitimate behavior constraints.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The request is a normal DTO change, HTTP migration, namespace edit, or Maven failure.

skills.name: senior-java
skills.description: Provides broad Java code-reading, implementation, testing, and maintainability guidance.
skills.useWhen: A general Java engineering workflow lacks a more specific framework or build procedure.
skills.doNotUseWhen: A narrow Skill uniquely covers Jakarta, RestClient, security, testing, or a Maven root cause.

skills.name: javax-to-jakarta-migration
skills.description: Migrates broad javax usage to Jakarta with a scan, mapping, build, and verification workflow.
skills.useWhen: A general Jakarta namespace conversion needs a broad cross-project procedure.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The active agent already lists the narrower project-frozen Jakarta procedure or an exact edit is supplied.

skills.name: java-refactoring-extract-method
skills.description: Extracts a focused Java method while preserving behavior and local tests.
skills.useWhen: The task is specifically an extract-method refactor in existing Java code.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task is a framework migration, security fix, HTTP client change, or build diagnosis.
